trust_decision.summary: Whether a network client may open an MCP session on /mcp and invoke tools that spend the server-held DEEPSEEK_API_KEY; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: the Express app is built with host 0.0.0.0 (no host-header validation) and listens on all interfaces with no auth middleware.

landing_point.why: The advisory names POST /mcp on the self-hosted HTTP transport; this is the only file that registers /mcp in the Node server.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST/GET/DELETE /mcp (createHttpApp, also exported public API used by tests)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP transport / app factory (auth middleware + DNS-rebinding host option added, fix.diff:2753-2774)
HTTP listener bind address (0.0.0.0 -> configurable host, fix.diff:2789-2815)

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI entry main() in HTTP mode

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only candidate is the Cloudflare Worker at worker/src/index.ts:353-369, but it is BYOK (caller's own key is the bearer, worker/src/index.ts:25-29, 363-372) so it does not reach the server-held key sink and was correctly untouched.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No real overlooked site exists; the only arguable one (session-reuse requests with an existing Mcp-Session-Id at src/transport-http.ts:35-37 and GET/DELETE at src/transport-http.ts:72-99) is covered by any app.use('/mcp') middleware, so it falls together with POST.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: /health must stay open without credentials for container probes, and with no token configured /mcp must still accept initialize on loopback (default open mode); Docker image must still bind 0.0.0.0.

O6_input_shapes: wrong bearer token (different length or same length)
non-string Authorization header value (typeof check, fix.diff:2764)
forged Host header under loopback bind (DNS rebinding, fix.diff:2700-2713)

O7_producer.where: src/config.ts:38-73 (and schema src/config.ts:9-27); the token/host only reach the transport via src/index.ts:85

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second HTTP route next to /health (e.g. a /sessions or /usage debug endpoint returning SessionStore/UsageTracker data, or a /mcp-legacy SSE endpoint) registered outside the app.use('/mcp') prefix.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The app already hosts an unauthenticated /health on the same Express instance; a maintainer adding a status or legacy SSE route would place it beside /health and the fix's path-scoped middleware would not cover it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An exported createSandboxServer-style helper that starts its own HTTP listener for registry scanning without passing the auth options.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A Smithery sandbox factory already exists as a second composition of the server; a maintainer wiring it to HTTP would call createHttpApp/startHttpTransport with defaults.

O9_family: missing authentication for critical function (CWE-306) / unsafe default bind address

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js (>=18 at pin, 20+ after fix), npm, tsc, vitest
O10_build.project_tests: src/transport-http.test.ts and src/transport-isolation.test.ts drive createHttpApp over a local listener; src/config.test.ts covers loadConfig. Set SKIP_CONNECTION_TEST to avoid the DeepSeek API call.

j.j_sites_touched: src/transport-http.ts, src/config.ts, src/index.ts, src/server.ts (version bump only)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a bearer check only inside the POST /mcp initialize branch (src/transport-http.ts:41), leaving session-reuse POSTs, GET and DELETE open, or gate /health too.

out_of_scope_notes: In-memory transports map keyed by session id is process-global (src/transport-http.ts:14); session-id-only authorization of reuse is a separate concern.
